UV Security Manager v1.0.0 for **64-bit Windows 10/11**.

Download **UV-Security-Manager-Setup.exe**, run it, install, and open the desktop shortcut. No Python installation or GitHub knowledge is required. On first launch, set your company name and administrator password.

Included: clients, sites, detailed product/asset records, warranty and AMC reminders, service jobs, invoice/quotation summaries, CSV export, printable reports and SQLite backups. Records are stored locally on your computer. No real client data is shipped with the app.

**Validation:** 17 automated data and native desktop checks passed on a Windows CI runner. The executable was built, the installer was installed, and the installed app was launched and verified to create its local database. This is not a certification on your specific Windows 10 computer.

Live view opens a configured authorized HTTPS camera portal; direct RTSP/ONVIF playback and website data synchronization are not included. Attachments are local file references and require separate backups. The local database is not encrypted. This is a single-PC edition and the installer is unsigned.

**UV-Security-Manager.exe** is an optional portable alternative. **QUICK-START.txt** has simple usage instructions; **SHA256SUMS.txt** records checksums for the executables.
